Description: Create Android Kotlin/Compose and FastAPI foundations, typed contracts, environment examples, and setup docs.
Acceptance Criteria: Android launches; API health endpoint works; placeholders for secrets; setup docs complete.

Summary: Local data model and offline repository
Description: Define Room entities for documents, extracted fields, medicines, review events, and sync state. Preserve unknown status.
Acceptance Criteria: Records persist and view offline; unknown distinct from current/past; migrations tested; no medical content in logs.

Description: Implement CameraX capture and image/PDF import. Preserve original files and handle invalid/large files safely.
Acceptance Criteria: Capture/import works; original reopens; errors actionable; formats documented.

Description: Build searchable/filterable library by date, type, and doctor label, with preview and extraction status.
Acceptance Criteria: Search/filter/open works; missing metadata shown as unknown; originals linked; empty/error states tested.

Description: Add provider-neutral OCR interface returning typed fields, confidence, and source location where available.
Acceptance Criteria: Malformed output rejected; uncertain fields flagged; missing values stay missing; synthetic OCR tests pass.

Description: Show original beside extracted fields, confidence/review state, edit/save actions. Keep raw OCR separate from normalized data.
Acceptance Criteria: Uncertain values marked; edits save; source opens; unresolved data never appears confirmed.

Description: Build reference adapter; preserve raw names; handle ambiguous mappings and combination products.
Acceptance Criteria: Verified mappings return ingredient IDs; ambiguous mappings unresolved; combination products and misspellings tested.

Description: Show history grouped by current/past/unknown, source, date, strength, and review status.
Acceptance Criteria: Every medicine links to source; status explicit; filters work; no automatic current assumption.

Description: Compare verified ingredient IDs and show source dates, strengths, formulation, and mapping status.
Acceptance Criteria: Matches flagged conservatively; strengths distinct; ambiguous mappings not definitive; evidence/disclaimer included.

Description: Show side-by-side findings with ingredient evidence, strength/date differences, and source links.
Acceptance Criteria: Evidence/sources shown; uncertainty labeled; no medication-change advice; review does not erase source.

Description: Build report builder with patient-entered details, confirmed allergies/conditions, medicine statuses, duplicate findings, reports, and source index.
Acceptance Criteria: Unconfirmed facts labeled; statuses separated; sources present; preview works; no facts invented.

Description: Generate readable PDF with selected sections, date, source index, limitations, and explicit share confirmation.
Acceptance Criteria: Only selected sections included; readable PDF; sharing requires action; file handled safely.

Description: Implement authentication, session handling, and server-side patient-scoped authorization.
Acceptance Criteria: Unauthorized requests fail; cross-user access blocked; tokens not logged/insecurely stored; tests pass.

Description: Implement opt-in backup, authenticated upload/download, encrypted object storage, retryable sync, and status.
Acceptance Criteria: Backup off until opt-in; status/errors visible; ownership enforced; retries safe; no sensitive logs.

Description: Add versioning and conflict resolution for edits, extraction versions, deletion markers, and retryable jobs.
Acceptance Criteria: Confirmed edits not silently overwritten; conflicts visible; uploads idempotent; offline/retry tests pass.

Description: Implement backup opt-in/out, export, deletion of local/cloud records, and retention explanations.
Acceptance Criteria: Consent recorded; deletion behavior documented/tested; retention limits visible; export usable.

Description: Share selected records/report after preview and explicit confirmation; use Android Sharesheet for MVP.
Acceptance Criteria: No automatic sharing; selection/preview required; secure links only if approved; access tests pass.

Description: Test cross-account access, IDOR, secrets, sensitive logs, local file exposure, transport, and deletion.
Acceptance Criteria: No critical/high issue remains for release; no medical content in logs; authorization tests pass.

Description: Add scalable text, TalkBack labels, contrast, touch targets, offline/error/loading states, low-storage handling.
Acceptance Criteria: Critical flows accessible; offline viewing works; errors actionable; UI states tested.

Description: Run end-to-end workflows with synthetic data; validate backup, report export, duplicate findings, deletion, accessibility, release notes.
Acceptance Criteria: Acceptance evidence complete; no release-blocking security issue; setup/rollback notes; limitations clear.
